name: Stormbringer: Storm Synergy lets Electrocute run through Stormflow and apply Conductive (#1360)
contract: #1360: Storm Synergy (578300) reads 'Your Electrocute can now be used while channeling Stormflow and causes it to apply Conductive'. Neither clause is delivered. Clause A: the core's only 'cast while channeling' gate is Unit::CanCastDuringChannel (src/server/game/Entities/Unit/Unit.cpp), consulted by Unit::SetCurrentCastedSpell, which otherwise calls InterruptSpell(CURRENT_CHANNELED_SPELL); it whitelists Tinker, Cultist, Starcaller, Necromancer, Demon Hunter and Witch Doctor and had no CLASS_STORMBRINGER branch. Stormflow's own allow-list is its Effect[1] aura 353, whose handler slot is 'nullptr' (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:418), and its class mask (6144, 128, 128) covers Shock (SpellFamilyFlags[0] 2048) and Brine (SpellFamilyFlags[1] 128) but not Electrocute (33554432, 2097152, 32). Clause B: 578300 is SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL -> 567559 with ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row, so SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs skips it (SpellMgr.cpp:2257) and Conductive is never cast. Conductive 567559 has DurationIndex 9 = 30000 ms and all three effects on TARGET_UNIT_CASTER. Ranks used are the ones a level-80 Stormbringer owns: Stormflow 572867 (from level 68) and Electrocute 501432 (from level 80). Electrocute has CastingTimeIndex 1 = 0 ms, so it is instant with or without the fix and its cast time is not a discriminator; the discriminators are that the channel survives and that Conductive appears. The dummy is dropped below 35 % health because Electrocute's own description restricts it to enemies below 35 % health. Postfix debug (session 1): the DISCRIMINATING Electrocute cast is protocol cast #4 in this scenario (Stormflow, Electrocute, Stormflow, Electrocute); result.json's cast_failures reports cast_count 4 for spell 501432 with reason 67 (SPELL_FAILED_NOT_READY, SharedDefines.h). This was first misattributed to the second Stormflow cast's shared 1.5 s GCD (category 133) and 'fixed' by bumping the pre-Electrocute wait from 1500 ms to 1700 ms; the failure persisted. Postfix debug (session 2): re-running with the 1700 ms wait still reproduced cast_count 4 / reason 67, and DBC lookup (Spell.dbc via coa-dbc-viewer) showed the real gate is Electrocute's own ability cooldown -- Category 978, CategoryRecoveryTime 6000 ms -- completely independent of its StartRecoveryCategory 133 / StartRecoveryTime 1500 ms GCD entry; Stormflow (572867) has Category 0 and does not share or extend that cooldown. Summing this scenario's actual step elapsed_ms from the BASELINE Electrocute cast (index 9) to the DISCRIMINATING Electrocute cast (index 21) gave only ~4706 ms of real gap (1000 + 2001 + 1705 from the three intervening waits) against a 6000 ms requirement, so the recast was correctly rejected as not ready. The 'Electrocute landed' spell_damage_count assertion still passed regardless because it is not scoped to a time window and was satisfied by the earlier, successful BASELINE Electrocute hit against the same dummy. The pre-Electrocute wait was increased to 3600 ms so the cumulative real gap since the BASELINE cast is ~6601 ms, >600 ms clear of the 6000 ms cooldown. The shared-GCD pattern fixed the same day for stormbringer-fix-static-electricity.json (commit 3c13018f3) and the Evergale cluster (commit dc8290b7f) is a different, unrelated mechanism (shared GCD, not a spell's own ability-cooldown category) and does not apply to this scenario's actual defect.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: Storm Synergy is not known yet
SETUP: the baseline Stormflow channel is running
Let the channel tick before interrupting it
BASELINE: without Storm Synergy, Electrocute ends the Stormflow channel
BASELINE: without Storm Synergy, Electrocute applies no Conductive
SETUP: Storm Synergy is an active passive
SETUP: the second Stormflow channel is running
Let Electrocute's own 6 s ability cooldown clear before recasting it
DISCRIMINATING: Electrocute landed while the channel was running
DISCRIMINATING: Storm Synergy keeps the Stormflow channel alive through Electrocute
DISCRIMINATING: that Electrocute applies Conductive to the caster
Conductive runs within its DBC duration (SpellDuration 9 = 30000 ms)
